verdict.rationale: EmailOctopus documents a REST API with v2 endpoints, pagination and rate limits, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. Human-readable HTML API docs do not count as a machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
